issues.description: The patch inserts an inline Verus `returns` clause into the signature of an already-verified executable getter instead of attaching the new contract with `#[verus_spec]`.
issues.rationale: `KVirtArea::range` already existed as verified executable Rust. The reviewed revision changes its function declaration to include an inline `returns self.range` clause. The reviewer asks whether the guideline prefers `verus_spec` and notes the function was already proven. The later addressing commit preserves the original executable signature and attaches exactly the same contract as `#[verus_spec(returns self.range)]`, explicitly recording that there are no additional executable changes relative to main; the same reviewer later approves. Under `preserve-exec-code`, a proof-only contract for existing executable code should use the external attribute form rather than rewriting the executable item syntax.
